knowledge_gaps: The compute estimate is understated: per-position recent windows require up to B×L window evaluations, rather than simply one additional full-sequence pass. Vectorization, chunking, memory limits, and runtime within the shared budget remain unspecified; implementation difficulty 4 appears optimistic.

The recent branch needs explicit padding and normalization semantics. If the backbone's receptive field spans at most eight interactions, the two representations may coincide under padding-invariant computation. Biases or normalization at padded positions can instead create artificial differences.

The added LayerNorm changes the baseline representation even when the gate favors full context, confounding attribution. Gate dimensions, initialization, short-history handling, and deterministic training–predictor equivalence checks are missing.

The report acknowledges established gated short/long-context methods but cites no direct precedents. Originality 5 and future potential 7 remain provisional without those comparisons or measured evidence.
